comment:
The signal input and the output carry whatever is patched in, so neither is given a family and neither is given a range.

The capture limit is a count of samples, not a duration: src/Lola.cpp:56 sets sampleMax to 192000 and the comment beside it assumes 48kHz. At 96kHz the same buffer holds two seconds.

src/Lola.cpp:79 takes the channel count from the signal input and src/Lola.cpp:208 hands it to the output unconditionally. With nothing patched to the signal input, getChannels returns 0 and the output is set to 0 channels even in the middle of playing a capture back.

The stop button has a lamp of its own which is lit only while the button is held (src/Lola.cpp:171); it is not an indication of the playback state.

There is no dataToJson or dataFromJson anywhere in this plugin, so the capture does not survive a patch save.

No module in this plugin has a context menu of its own.
